fields.why: 2024 current-use prevalences are reported for six race/ethnicity groups and ranked (AI/AN highest), an outcome measured per SPD group.
Race/ethnicity is the only SPD with 3+ groups compared; sex and school level have two groups each.
The t-tests assess 2023-to-2024 changes within each group (period comparisons), not differences across race groups; the cross-group ranking has no test. The mechanical flag is a false alarm.
